verdict.rationale: Grok's docs show the model accepts image input: image understanding is documented, and the grok-4.7 spec card scopes modalities as "text, image → text". Documents can be attached to chat messages and searched via attachment_search, and audio is handled through a separate speech-to-text API. Because the spec card honestly states the model's input modalities, the story's 'or honestly scoped' clause is met. Missing for 10: native audio input to the chat model itself (audio goes only through the separate STT endpoint), documented image input limits such as formats and sizes, and independent hands-on corroboration of multimodal input.

support.subject: As a developer, I can send images, audio, or documents to the model — or the docs honestly scope the model to text-only input

citations.quote: Some models allow images in the input. The model will consider the image context when generating the response.
Grok can search through and reason over documents you attach to chat messages
Transcribe audio files into text with a single API call, or stream audio in real time over WebSocket.
